Basic chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with system and user messages

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 16, messages: [{ 'content' => 'You are a helpful assistant.', 'role' => 'system' }, { 'content' => 'Say hello in one word.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022', temperature: 0))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.content.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
puts result.model.inspect
puts result.usage.total_tokens.inspect
```
